env GO111MODULE=on
# Explicit environment control: scrub any ambient GODEBUG so the directives
# below, not inherited environment values, determine the annotation state.
env GODEBUG=

[!GOOS:linux] skip
[short] skip

# Programs with //go:debug decoratemappings=0 should never see annotations.
# This ensures that the runtime has not overridden the default.
go run .

# Opposite-default control: the Go 1.25 runtime default is decoratemappings=1.
# With the directive explicitly enabling, annotations must appear, proving the
# mechanism works and the assertion above fails whenever the directive is not
# honored.
cd control
go run .

-- go.mod --
go 1.25
module m

-- main.go --
//go:debug decoratemappings=0
package main

import (
	"log"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("/proc/self/maps")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Error reading: %v", err)
	}

	if strings.Contains(string(b), "[anon: Go:") {
		log.Printf("/proc/self/maps:\n%s", string(b))
		log.Fatalf("/proc/self/maps contains Go annotation")
	}
}

-- control/go.mod --
go 1.25
module control

-- control/main.go --
//go:debug decoratemappings=1
package main

import (
	"log"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("/proc/self/maps")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Error reading: %v", err)
	}

	if !strings.Contains(string(b), "[anon: Go:") {
		log.Printf("/proc/self/maps:\n%s", string(b))
		log.Fatalf("/proc/self/maps lacks Go annotation")
	}
}
